mapper.sql: m.MEMBER_SEQ IN (SELECT a.MEMBER_SEQ FROM ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.ATTEND_DATE >= #{weekStart} AND a.ATTEND_DATE < #{weekEnd}) AND m.ROLE <> 'ROLE_ADMIN'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.MEMBER_SEQ) FROM ATTENDANCE a JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = a.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE a.ATTEND_DATE >= #{weekStart} AND a.ATTEND_DATE < #{weekEnd} AND m.ROLE <> 'ROLE_ADMIN') AS active_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE a JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = a.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE a.ATTEND_DATE >= #{weekStart} AND a.ATTEND_DATE < #{weekEnd} AND m.ROLE <> 'ROLE_ADMIN') AS attend_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE CREATED_AT >= #{weekStart} AND CREATED_AT < #{weekEnd} AND ROLE <> 'ROLE_ADMIN') AS new_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BLIND_MATCHING WHERE MATCHED_AT >= #{weekStart} AND MATCHED_AT < #{weekEnd}) AS blind_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BLIND_MATCHING WHERE MATCHED_AT >= #{weekStart} AND MATCHED_AT < #{weekEnd} AND STATUS = 'CONTINUED') AS blind_continued, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IDEAL_MATCHING WHERE MATCHED_AT >= #{weekStart} AND MATCHED_AT < #{weekEnd}) AS ideal_count FROM DUAL
SELECT m.GENDER AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 1) AS pct FROM MEMBER m WHERE GROUP BY m.GENDER ORDER BY m.GENDER

SELECT AGE_BASE || '대' AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 1) AS pct FROM ( SELECT FLOOR((#{weekYear} - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.BIRTH_DATE)) / 10) * 10 AS AGE_BASE FROM MEMBER m WHERE ) GROUP BY AGE_BASE ORDER BY AGE_BASE

SELECT SIDO AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 1) AS pct FROM ( SELECT CASE REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(m.ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 1) WHEN '서울특별시' THEN '서울' WHEN '세종특별자치시' THEN '세종' WHEN '강원특별자치도' THEN '강원' WHEN '전북특별자치도' THEN '전북' WHEN '제주특별자치도' THEN '제주' ELSE NVL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(m.ADDRESS1), '[^ ]+', 1, 1), '기타') END AS SIDO FROM MEMBER m WHERE ) GROUP BY SIDO ORDER BY cnt DESC, label

SELECT TO_CHAR(w.WEEK_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week_start, NVL(n.CNT, 0) AS new_members, NVL(a.MEMBERS, 0) AS active_members, NVL(a.CNT, 0) AS attend_count, NVL(b.CNT, 0) AS blind_count, NVL(i.CNT, 0) AS ideal_count FROM (SELECT CAST(#{lastWeekStart} AS DATE) - 7 * (LEVEL - 1) AS WEEK_START FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{weeks}) w LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRUNC(CREATED_AT, 'IW') AS WS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM MEMBER WHERE CREATED_AT >= #{rangeStart} AND CREATED_AT < #{rangeEnd} AND ROLE <> 'ROLE_ADMIN' GROUP BY TRUNC(CREATED_AT, 'IW')) n ON n.WS = w.WEEK_START LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRUNC(ad.ATTEND_DATE, 'IW') AS WS, COUNT(DISTINCT ad.MEMBER_SEQ) AS MEMBERS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM ATTENDANCE ad JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = ad.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE ad.ATTEND_DATE >= #{rangeStart} AND ad.ATTEND_DATE < #{rangeEnd} AND m.ROLE <> 'ROLE_ADMIN' GROUP BY TRUNC(ad.ATTEND_DATE, 'IW')) a ON a.WS = w.WEEK_START LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRUNC(MATCHED_AT, 'IW') AS WS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BLIND_MATCHING WHERE MATCHED_AT >= #{rangeStart} AND MATCHED_AT < #{rangeEnd} GROUP BY TRUNC(MATCHED_AT, 'IW')) b ON b.WS = w.WEEK_START LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRUNC(MATCHED_AT, 'IW') AS WS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM IDEAL_MATCHING WHERE MATCHED_AT >= #{rangeStart} AND MATCHED_AT < #{rangeEnd} GROUP BY TRUNC(MATCHED_AT, 'IW')) i ON i.WS = w.WEEK_START ORDER BY w.WEEK_START
